test_title: PYST 162: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 08 Feb, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusion(s) logically follows/follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

All fields are gardens.

All gardens are parks.

Some gardens are apartments.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some apartments are parks.

II. All fields are parks.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
